This is a standard looking clone, although one nice feature is it consistently produces those coppery heads. It's certainly a nice individual, and it's quite a vigorous grower as well.

Yeah, it looked healthy when I planted it. Never put out any thing, so I checked and it wss rotted. So strange because all my other plants are in the same container and are fine.
Also, I let the water evaporate almost completely before rewatering. They don't sit in tubs of water for extended periods of time. Idk. But its fine. More room for those seedlings
